<subject>Re: Meridian Net Works' Corporate and Compliance</subject>
<body>
At the end of my 3:00 meeting with Raymond and Dean today I will confirm the details regarding the international travel arrangements. I find it unlikely that Raymond, Chelsea Smith, or Dean Gould would accept economy class flights to Cambridge. I will update you shortly.  -Maureen
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Webb, Dawn  
Sent:	Monday, 6 May 2024 09:02
To:	Woodward, Maureen
Subject:	FW: Meridian Net Works' Corporate and Compliance

Dawn

 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Meridian Announcements/Corp/Meridian@meridianlaw.com  On Behalf Of Office of the Chairman - Meridian Net Works LLP@meridianlaw.com
Sent:	Friday, 3 May 2024 08:01
To:	ENW-Employees_London@meridianlaw.com
Subject:	Meridian Net Works' Corporate and Compliance

Contact Sharon Williams or Hazel Dunn for any travel policy inquiries.
